title: The Stilt House
text: A house on stilts above the bog, crooked and black with damp, a light in the window. The ladder has been pulled up. As you come close, the light goes out. Something shifts on the boards overhead.

options.label: Call up to whoever is inside, and ask for shelter.

outcomes.text: A family of eel-catchers, who let down the ladder and let you sleep dry.
No one answers, and the boards above go very still.

options.label: The quickest shins up a stilt, to learn who put out the light.

outcomes.text: Empty, a meal still warm on the table, and a window facing the road ahead.

options.label: Pass under the house. Whoever is up there wants no visitors.

outcomes.text: Something drops from under the floor.
